description: Verify a VIN passes the ISO 3779 / 49 CFR §565.15 check-digit checksum. Pure local math, no network call — useful for catching typos before consuming a paid API call. A valid checksum proves the VIN is well-formed but does NOT prove it was actually issued by a manufacturer.

vin.description: Candidate VIN to validate (will be uppercased; whitespace stripped).

name: validate_vin_check_digit
title: Validate VIN check digit (offline)
